lines.en: I stride forward through fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的脚步很沉。
lines.en: My steps are heavy in the conifer wood.
I lift my head to reach higher branches.
My body presses hard on the ground.
I walk across a patch of moss.

lines.zh: 宽尾巴把雪枝扫到一边。
lines.en: My broad tail sweeps the snowy branches aside.
I walk slowly, but powerfully.
I follow the few ahead.

lines.zh: 我一低头就能咬到嫩枝。
lines.en: One dip of my head and I reach tender shoots.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌在雪地上留印。
lines.en: My feet leave prints in the snow.
I turn sideways between two trees.
I stop and listen.
I turn and look behind.
I lean my back against a tree.
I stand in the middle of the wood.
Needles settle on my broad back.
I chew pine shoots slowly.
The snow here hasn't melted.
My breath fogs white.
Looking up at the conifer canopy.
Only wind in the conifers.

lines.zh: 换条腿站着，另一条歇歇。
lines.en: I shift to the other leg for a rest.
Our scent is all over this area.
I nudge the snow with my nose.
I let out a long plume of fog.
A little longer; the snow is easing.
I shift my feet.
The snow creaks underfoot.

lines.zh: 你从雪线那边慢慢过来。
lines.en: You come slowly from the snowline.

lines.zh: 你进林子时我就看见你了。
lines.en: I spotted you when you entered the grove.
I'm steadier than the small ones.
You're standing three paces off.
I'll accept that distance.

lines.zh: 鸭嘴龙看得出你空着手。
lines.en: The hadrosaur can tell your hands are empty.
That's good.
You're standing right in my way.
I'll go around, not through.
I walk mine, you walk yours.

lines.zh: 你的靴声我隔着针叶都听见。
lines.en: I hear your boots through the needles.
I don't need to raise my head to see you.
That blow landed on my back.
I shifted half a step.
Snow hides half the blood.
That only reached the hide.
Needles fell all over me.
I turn my head back slowly.
You're not weak.
I'm still steady on the snow.
I keep that blow in my bones.
I snort out a hot breath.

lines.zh: 你手里那束草，是给我的？
lines.en: Is that bundle of grass for me?
Not enough for me.
Just put it down.
I smell pine needles.
Your offering is too thin.
I'm walking over.
Get back behind the tree.
I won't snatch.
Let me sniff it first.
This browse isn't what I usually eat.
You hit my flank.
I barely shifted.
I have more ballast than you.
Don't lean on my shoulder blade.
I turn, and you must step aside.
We both hit a tree.
A layer of needles shook loose.
You slipped half a step in the snow.
I shift my weight onto my front feet.
The path here was already narrow.
There are several in this wood.
We move together.
Don't stand so close.

lines.zh: 她踏着针叶走在我前头。
lines.en: She walks ahead of me through the needles.

lines.zh: 我们的长脖子互相蹭了蹭。
lines.en: Our long necks brushed together.
You don't need to watch.
This wood feeds us well.
We go slowly, so let's go together.
Our prints stay in the snow.
Go your own way.

lines.zh: 我低头看了一眼那堆东西。
lines.en: I lower my head toward the pile.
That wouldn't fill my mouth.
I eat only needles and grass.
I pressed it into the snow.
Did you lose this?
I nudged it aside with my snout.
It isn't in the way.
I keep walking through the needles.

lines.zh: 这点枝叶不够我嚼两下。
lines.en: This much browse isn't two mouthfuls.
You had best keep it.
You raised your hand.

lines.zh: 针叶缝里，我早看见你了。
lines.en: I saw you through the needles already.

lines.zh: 你抬手的样子我不喜欢。
lines.en: I don't like the way you raise that arm.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我啃低处的枝叶。
lines.en: In the taiga, I browse the low branches.
This is the stance before a charge.
One more step and I charge.
Back past the treeline and I stop.
You don't move, so neither do I.
My hind legs are braced.
I know this wood.
If you bolt, I'll follow.
The trees here will trip you.

lines.zh: 我这一身肉，撞上就够呛。
lines.en: This much bulk, a hit is enough.
This won't last long.

lines.zh: 我这群鸭嘴龙，走成一片。
lines.en: Our duckbill herd moves as one.
The snow in the wood is thin.
My prints are deeper than yours.
You hid behind a tree.
A tree won't stop my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我踩着松针一步步逼近。
lines.en: Step by step I press through the litter.
You moved to another tree.
I follow again.
You don't know this place like I do.
There's a fallen log ahead.
I can step over it.
You must go around. I don't.
You turned your head toward me.
My duck bill grazes the low grass.
Last few steps; the ground shakes.
Between two trees, I stopped.

lines.zh: 这样一来你就没退路了。
lines.en: Now you have no way back.
I turn my shoulder into the charge.
You slid several steps on the snow.
I push with my head.
You backed onto a root.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩下去，雪都溅了。
lines.en: One stomp sends snow flying.
The snow was packed hard.
You barely dodged.
The ground thuds under that blow.
My tail caught you.
You nearly fell.
I turn my body.

lines.zh: 我的侧腹比你的盾还宽。
lines.en: My flank is wider than your shield.
You're pushed against a trunk.
The trunk cracked.
I shove once more.
I crowd you until you can't stand straight.

lines.zh: 我从云杉后头慢慢挪出来。
lines.en: I ease out from behind a spruce.
Snow falls from the needles.
I'm bigger than the rest.
Our scent is all through this wood.
I pack the snow step by step.
Standing there, you're very small.
I don't plan to act yet.
My breathing sounds loud in the snow.
This wood can feed us.
Don't stand too far off.

lines.zh: 鸭嘴一低，我把头对着你。
lines.en: Duck bill low, I point my head at you.

lines.zh: 我的脚步把雪压出一道槽。
lines.en: My steps press a groove in the snow.
I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 这片针叶林只有我们两个。
lines.en: Only the two of us in this spruce wood.
You move first.
I've packed a path through the snow.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，毛都焦了。
lines.en: Fire caught my back and singed the hide.

lines.zh: 滑下坡的时候，我用腿撑住了。
lines.en: I braced with my legs as I slid down.

lines.zh: 水到了脖子，我用力蹬着。
lines.en: Water reached my neck. I kicked hard.
The shock made me miss a step.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我们成群啃枝。
lines.en: In the conifers, we browse in groups.
The white flash turned the wood livid.

lines.zh: 雪埋住了草，我找不到吃的。
lines.en: Snow covers the grass. I can't find food.

lines.zh: 雷打在林子上，我整只都震了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the wood and shook through me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有雪，也没有松针。
lines.en: No snow underfoot, no pine needles.
